gap.$description: Gap between actions in a spaced group.

seam-overlap.$description: Shared-edge overlap between adjacent attached actions.

attached-radius.$description: Radius of the logical corners along a shared button edge.

padding.$description: Toolbar frame inset and divider margin.

divider-size.$description: Block size of a vertical toolbar separator.

bg-image.$description: Optional decorative image over the toolbar surface.

fg.$description: Default toolbar foreground on its raised surface.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete optional backdrop filter for the toolbar surface.

border-width.$description: Thickness of the toolbar frame and divider.

radius.$description: Logical outside radius of the toolbar frame.
